articles.title: Scientists discover 210-million-year-old dinosaur in Zimbabwe - Phys.org
articles.description: A newly discovered dinosaur from Zimbabwe is offering fresh clues to how the animals diversified, suggesting they spread across distinct ecosystems in southern Africa, scientists said Wednesday.
